thread:
sasha: Heads-up: planning a small routing-policy rollout to EU-edge tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Aim: shift 8% traffic to new policy for 2h then evaluate. Will need DNS TTL quiesce and quick smoke checks. Who can own the deploy and rollback window?

mike: I can own the deploy window. I’ll be online 09:30–11:30 UTC.

anna: I’ll do smoke checks + latency sampling. What exact checks do you want? p50/p95, error rates, and a few synthetic flows?

ravi: I can standby for rollback and monitor infra metrics (gpu pools, router errors). Please post the exact target policy name and DNS change plan.

sasha: Thanks. Policy name: routing-policy-eu-v3. DNS plan: no aggressive TTL swap — we’ll set app-level quiesce by reducing route weight gradually; only a small DNS bump for edge discovery. Steps below: 

1) Preflight (09:30–09:50 UTC): confirm canary model pinned, health checks passing in staging, certs ok.

2) Quiesce TTL (09:50): set DNS TTL to 60s for the next 45m to make any small rollbacks quick. (We’ll revert after roll complete.)

3) Initial shift (10:00): route weight +2% immediately -> wait 5m -> +6% -> wait 10m -> +8% (steady).

4) Smoke (10:10 onwards): Anna runs the smoke checklist: p50/p95 latency, 500-sample synthetics for chat & embeddings, 429/5xx rate, and token throughput delta. Post results in thread.

5) Monitoring: Ravi watches cluster health (node CPU/GPU mem), proxy error spikes, and queue lengths. We’ve got tracing on for these flows.

6) Rollback window: 10:00–12:00 UTC. If any critical alert (>=3% error increase or p95 > baseline+200ms sustained 3 minutes) we revert to routing-policy-eu-v2 and TTL back to previous.

7) Post-mortem/notes: quick post in #eng-platform with perf numbers and decision.

mike: Clear. I’ll run the route weight API and the DNS TTL change. Which DNS owner paged if something goes wrong?

sasha: @ravi you’re primary for immediate rollback ops. DNS owner is infra-dns (oncall: @anna for today if we need sign-off).

anna: I’ll collect smoke samples. Quick checklist I’ll run (copying here):
- run: curl -I https://eu.api.redwood.test/health
- trace synthetic chat 100x -> record p50/p95
- embed batch 10 -> check token/time
- check for 429s in last 10m

ravi: Confirmed. I’ll set a dashboard watch and an alert scope: error-rate > 3% OR p95 lat increase > 200ms for 3m. I’ll also have a rollback script ready:

``` 
# rollback snippet
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/routes/shift \
  -d '{"policy":"routing-policy-eu-v2","target_weight":100}' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN"
# restore DNS TTL
kubectl patch configmap dns-config -n infra -p '{"data":{"ttl":"300"}}'
```

mike: Nice. Can we make the initial +2% a manual confirmation step? I’d like to make the first step gated by Anna’s green on preflight.

sasha: Yes — gate the +2% on Anna ack. mike, do NOT push anything until Anna says "green".

deploy-bot: Deployment window created: eu-edge-rollout-1765439999. Owners: mike (deploy), anna (smoke), ravi (rollback). Reminder 09:50 UTC TTL quiesce.

anna: Preflight now: staging health OK, models pinned, no cert issues. Ready for mike to stage the +2% once I mark green. Running synthetic run now (ETA 5m).

mike: Holding. Waiting for anna green.

anna: GREEN — staging smoke looks fine. p95 within baseline. No regressions in synthetic chat. Proceed with initial +2%.

mike: Applying +2% now. Will post exact command output.

mike: Command output: {"status":"ok","new_weights":{"routing-policy-eu-v3":2}} :thumbsup:

anna: Monitoring: initial 5m check. p50 stable, p95 +10ms, errors unchanged. No 5xx.

ravi: infra metrics nominal. No cpu/gpu spikes. Traces show slight route variance as expected.

mike: Proceeding to +6% after 5m.

mike: Applied +6% -> cumulative now 8%? (I applied +4%) Response: {"status":"ok","new_weights":{"routing-policy-eu-v3":8}}

anna: Running 10m window. p95 still within +40ms. 429 rates unchanged. Synthetic embeddings throughput looks good.

ravi: Keeping watch. No alerts.

sasha: If no regressions at 30m mark, we keep policy live and start roll verification. Plan to keep this at 8% for 2h as planned. Anna will post the summary at 11:00 UTC.

mike: Noted. I’ll keep deploy logs archived under eu-edge-rollout-1765439999.

anna: 11:00 summary: p50 baseline, p95 +30ms average, no error delta >0.5%, token cost unchanged. Recommend keep live.

ravi: Agreed. No infra red flags. We can extend traffic later if product wants.

sasha: Thanks team. I’ll close the window and revert DNS TTL to 300s now. mike/ravi/anna — please ack when you see TTL restored.

mike: TTL restore command executed.

ravi: TTL back to 300s confirmed.

anna: Acked. Posting short postmortem in #eng-platform with perf numbers and the rollback snippet + logs.

sasha: Great run. Leaving notes: keep the gated +2% pattern for next rollouts, and consider automated preflight checks for staging. :party_popper:
